name: The False Princess
source:
I was hunting demons, and I remembered a story...
The story of how Mira and I met.
She's mine a childhood friend.
I met her one day when I was trying to find magic nuts.
Mira didn't see me, we talked through the window. But I certainly gave her the impression of a mysterious fighter against evil. Yes, I am!
And I'm sure she's crazy about me!
She's like a real Princess... And the Hero (me), always comes to rescue of the Princess!
And in the end, they live happily ever after. Really?
I just don't remember how it ended.
I guess I just went hunting demons.

[From [url=https://gyn9.itch.io/the-false-princess]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我在猎杀恶魔时，想起了一个故事……
那是我和米拉相遇的故事。
她是我的青梅竹马。
有一天，我正在寻找魔法坚果，就这样遇见了她。
米拉没有见到我的样子，我们隔着窗户交谈。不过，我肯定给她留下了一个对抗邪恶的神秘战士的印象。没错，我就是这样的人！
而且我敢肯定，她已经迷上我了！
她就像一位真正的公主……而英雄，也就是我，总会前去拯救公主！
最后，两人从此幸福地生活在一起。真是这样吗？
我只是记不起结局了。
我想，我大概是继续猎杀恶魔去了。

（摘自[url=https://gyn9.itch.io/the-false-princess]itch.io[/url]）
